install:
set -euo pipefail
APP_DIR="${EASTLEDGE_APP_DIR:-$HOME/eastledge-wages}"
if [ ! -f "$APP_DIR/package.json" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/EastledgeLtd/eastledge-wages.git "$APP_DIR"
fi
cd "$APP_DIR"
npm ci
npm run build
start:
set -euo pipefail
APP_DIR="${EASTLEDGE_APP_DIR:-$HOME/eastledge-wages}"
if [ ! -f "$APP_DIR/.next/BUILD_ID" ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$APP_DIR/package.json" ]; then
    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/EastledgeLtd/eastledge-wages.git "$APP_DIR"
  fi
  cd "$APP_DIR"
  npm ci
  npm run build
fi
cd "$APP_DIR"
export AUTH_SECRET="${AUTH_SECRET:-eastledge-dev-secret}"
export NODE_ENV=production
exec npm run start
